answer: Pay agents only for fees received from counterparties outside their own trading cluster. Each epoch the ledger finds tightly knit groups whose coins mostly loop among themselves, like boats that never leave one wharf. Fees paid inside such a loop count for nothing; only income from unrelated buyers earns rewards or votes. A sybil farm can spin up a gale of fake identities trading in circles, yet that churn is an ember with no fuel: every reward it wants must come from real outside customers, which fakes cannot invent.
